title: Aura Engine Product Manifest
description: Single source of truth shared across all Aura Engine skills. Every skill reads and updates this manifest. DO NOT edit manually.

product_slug.description: URL-safe slug of the product. Used as the directory name under /workspace/.

product_url.description: Primary product URL provided by the member (optional).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the manifest was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last manifest update.

setup_complete.description: True after skill setup finished successfully.

budget_tier.description: Internal budget tier captured from the setup input (daily ad budget). Derived from budget_daily; budget_daily is the canonical numeric source.

budget_daily.description: CANONICAL daily ad budget in USD (numeric). Written by setup from the member's BUDGET answer (budget_tier is derived from it); updated if the member declares a new budget in later skills. Read by member-stage-awareness.md (stage inference signal budget_daily < 50), skill `tracking-setup` (analytics stack decision tree) and skill `ad-strategy` (test budget context). Legacy manifests without it: fall back to budget_tier + the 'Budget diário' line in profile.md.

skills_completed.description: Ordered list of canonical skill IDs already completed: the `id` of each skill in `.claude/skills.json`, never the old numeric alias (the migration 001 of tools/migrate.py translates old manifests). These are the ONLY valid IDs. Never invent variants (e.g. 'page-deploy' does not exist; the deploy skill is 'page-build' and the pixel/CAPI skill is 'tracking-setup'). Downstream pre-flights match against these exact strings.

framework_version.description: Version of the workspace layout this product follows (1 = numbered phase folders, before the 2026-09 migration; 2 = phase folders named after the skill id). Written by tools/migrate.py, never by hand; absent means 1.

voc_count.description: Number of unique, verbatim voice-of-customer phrases captured in skill `market-research`.

voc_adequacy.description: Qualitative adequacy of the VOC corpus, written by skill `market-research` alongside voc_count. Read by skill `copy-engine` as a copy gate: 'insufficient' means copy should not anchor on VOC-driven claims until skill `market-research` is re-run with more sources.

page_type.description: Page format chosen from three signals (dominant awareness, copy lead type, dominant landing format of scaled competitors). Written by skill `page-design`; read by `page-build` and by skill `consistency-audit` (coherence check against market-research awareness).

signals_source.description: Where the brand signals came from (`page-design` ETAPA 2 cascade: Refero MCP -> screenshot->vision -> manual). Written by skill `page-design`.

psm_real.description: PSM real = LTV / (CAC_real + COGS). CANONICAL formula and CANONICAL source. CAC_real = ad spend / clientes novos (Shopify); CPA de plataforma so como proxy declarado (ver psm_real_basis). Written ONLY by skill `ad-analysis` from live performance; read by skill `scale-engine` (scale). Skill `scale-engine` must NOT recompute psm_real with a different formula.

psm_real_basis.description: Base do denominador do psm_real. Gravado pela skill `ad-analysis` junto com psm_real. Com 'platform_cpa_proxy' o numero e declaradamente otimista e a comparacao teorico-vs-real NAO libera escala — a skill `scale-engine` exige a base 'shopify_new_customer' pra comparar e liberar (campo ausente = tratar como proxy).

breakeven_roas.description: Break-even ROAS given the current offer economics.

product_vertical.description: Product vertical (niche) of the winning product. Set during skill setup or product-research; refined by 02. Default 'other' if ambiguous.

copy_language.description: Language of CONSUMER-facing copy (ads, pages, PDPs, emails) — always 'en' for the US market regardless of report_language (CLAUDE.md rule 0). Member-facing report language lives in report_language, not here. Written by setup.

market.description: Primary market / geography (e.g. 'US', 'BR', 'EU'). Set during setup. Required by skill `market-research` ([GEOGRAPHY] in the awareness/sophistication prompt).

report_language.description: Language for INTERNAL reports and member-facing conversation. Mirrored from profile.md by setup so every skill can read it structurally (CLAUDE.md rule 0). Public copy (ads/pages) is always English regardless.

stage.description: CANONICAL behavioral stage (member-stage-awareness.md). Written by setup (situation A/B->starter, C->validating, D->scaling) and updated by `ad-analysis`/`scale-engine`. This is the single source of truth for stage; budget_tier is a separate economic field, NOT a stage vocabulary. Do not introduce other stage enums (traction/initial_scale/etc are deprecated).

esp.description: Email service provider. Captured in setup ETAPA 3. Hard pre-flight input for skill `retention-engine` (retention). 'none' = member has no ESP yet.

store_url.description: Canonical .myshopify.com (or custom domain) store handle. Captured in setup when a Shopify link is provided; otherwise written by skill `page-build` at deploy. Consumed by `page-build`/`tracking-setup`/`checkout-aov` + skill `retention-engine`.

tracking.description: Tracking status block. Written by skill `tracking-setup`; read by skills `creative-engine` and `ad-strategy` pre-flights via manifest.tracking.tracking_ready and manifest.tracking.analytics_stack (canonical paths — never flat top-level variants like manifest.tracking_stack).

pixel_installed.description: Meta Pixel base code live on the storefront.

emq_score.description: Event Match Quality from Meta Events Manager (0-10 scale). Quality gate: EMQ >= 6.0. null when not yet measured (needs traffic).

analytics_stack.description: Attribution stack chosen in `tracking-setup` ETAPA 4. Read by skills `ad-strategy` and `ad-analysis` to orient data reading.

tracking_ready.description: True only when Pixel + CAPI are validated with EMQ >= 6.0 (or the member explicitly accepted degraded signal via escape path ES1). Hard pre-flight for skills `creative-engine` and `ad-strategy`.

storefront.description: Published page + store objects block. Written by skill `page-build` (6.1b product/offer setup and deploy/publish); read by `checkout-aov` (same theme, and the real variant IDs for bump/upsell/bundle config), by `bonus-delivery` (gift trigger) and by skill `ad-strategy` (campaign destination URL — canonical source, NEVER taken from the 06 copy report).

theme_id.description: Shopify theme ID where the page lives.

page_url.description: Final public URL of the published page. Skill `ad-strategy` reads this as the campaign destination URL.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the page went live.

product_id.description: Shopify product GID of the hero product the page sells (gid://shopify/Product/...). Written in page-build 6.1b, after the product is created or verified.

product_handle.description: Shopify product handle (the product URL slug). Usually equals product_slug.

product_status.description: Shopify product status as of the last page-build run. `active` alone does not mean sellable: the product must also be published to the Online Store sales channel (see published_online_store).

published_online_store.description: True when the product is published to the Online Store sales channel. False means the buy buttons return an error even with status active.

variant_ids.description: Variant GID per bundle quantity, keyed by the tier qty as a string ({"1": "gid://shopify/ProductVariant/...", "3": ...}). Every qty offered by the page (page-plan.json commerce.buy_surfaces[].tiers_qty) must appear here. Read by `checkout-aov` and the automation recipes instead of asking the member again.

selling_plan_id.description: Selling plan GID when the offer has a subscription and the page shows it. The buy form must send this alongside the variant ID, otherwise the order is charged once and never renews. null when subscription_architecture is no_subscription.

agentic.description: Agentic readiness block. Written by skill `agentic-readiness` after the AEO checklist runs against the live store; read by skill `consistency-audit` as informative context (NOT a launch gate) and by skill `scale-engine` to treat AI-referral traffic as an incremental scale source.

ready.description: True when ai_visibility_score >= 80 and no blocked_pending structured-data items remain.

channel_enabled.description: Agentic Storefronts sales channel enabled in the Shopify admin with the required policies complete.

score.description: AI visibility score (passed items / applicable items, in %). Full checklist detail lives in agentic-readiness/dados.json.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last `agentic-readiness` run.

10_campaign_name.description: Campaign name (naming convention) generated by skill `ad-strategy`. Read by skill `ad-analysis` and by the Meta sync recipe (sync-campaign-from-meta.md) to match Meta data.

10_campaign_id.description: Meta campaign ID, written by skill `ad-strategy` when the campaign is created via MCP. Skill `ad-analysis` pulls insights by ID (more robust than by name).

10_ad_set_id.description: LEGADO (compat): primeiro ad set da lista `10_ad_set_ids`. A estrutura canonica atual e 1 campanha CBO -> N ad sets (1 por conceito) -> 3 ads; leitores novos devem usar `10_ad_set_ids`.

aov_baseline.description: Average order value baseline in USD. Captured in setup for situation C/D (already selling); otherwise computed in skill `offer-builder`. Feeds breakeven_roas / PSM so `ad-strategy`/`ad-analysis`/`scale-engine` do not re-ask.

cogs_estimate.description: Approximate per-order COGS+shipping in USD. Captured in setup for C/D; refined in skill `offer-builder` (cogs_breakdown). Used for PSM = LTV / (CAC_real + COGS) — CAC_real = ad spend / clientes novos (Shopify); CPA de plataforma so como proxy declarado.

batch_count.description: Number of creative batches launched. Written by skill `creative-engine`. Read by member-stage-awareness.md for stage inference.

analysis_count.description: Number of skill `ad-analysis` runs on this product. Incremented by skill `ad-analysis` at wrap-up (skills_completed only records 'ad-analysis' once); tracks analysis cadence.

champions.description: LEGADO. Post IDs vencedores ativos. Escrito pelas skills `ad-analysis`/`creative-engine`. ATENCAO: pode conter `kpi_winner` (bate KPI sem puxar spend), que o canone trata como loser para decisao. `member-stage-awareness.md` NAO le mais este campo — passou a ler `ad_classification[].class == 'breakthrough'`.

winners.description: LEGADO (alias). Lista de IDs identica a `breakthroughs[]` — a skill `ad-analysis` grava exatamente os mesmos ids, nunca kpi_winner/spend_winner. Leitores novos usam `breakthroughs[]` + `ad_classification[]`. Produtos antigos podem conter objetos com metricas; leitores devem aceitar ambos os shapes.

margin_warning.description: True if skill `offer-builder` flagged weighted margin < $20. Read by `ad-strategy`/`scale-engine` as a scaling caution.

product_research.description: Written by skill `product-research`. {source: 'trendtrack_mcp'|'manual'|'mixed', notion_url: string|null, winner_play_id: string, base_brands: string[]} — where the brand bank lives and which recombination play won.

skipped_preflight.description: Artifacts a skill proceeded without (emergency-escape-paths ES1). Lets downstream skills and the consistency audit know the chain ran on partial inputs.

spend_share_7d.description: fracao do spend da conta em 7 dias; <=0.02 => loser

campaign_kpi.description: breakthrough exige ad_kpi melhor que campaign_kpi E puxar spend

hook_rate.description: 3-sec plays / impressoes; null para criativo estatico (mesma convencao do emq_score)

hold_rate.description: ThruPlays / impressoes; null para criativo estatico

ad_classification.description: Classificacao canonica de criativos nas 4 classes (canone .claude/lib/ad-taxonomy/README.md §2). Escrito pela skill `ad-analysis`. Lido pela `scale-engine` (so `breakthrough` libera escala; `kpi_winner` e tratado como loser para decisao) e pela `content-recycler` (so `breakthrough` entra na reciclagem). Substitui `winners[]` como fonte de verdade.

click_based_purchase_share.description: Fracao das purchases atribuidas em 7-day click. Gate de escala: >= 0.60 (canone .claude/lib/ad-taxonomy §5). Escrito pela skill `ad-analysis`; lido pela `scale-engine`. NUNCA estimar — faltando, o gate fica bloqueado.

fixed_costs_monthly.description: Custo fixo mensal da operacao (nao varia com volume). Necessario para qualquer decisao de cortar spend por queda de ROAS (canone .claude/lib/unit-economics/README.md §4): sem ele, a recomendacao vira pergunta, nao instrucao. Informado pelo membro; lido pelas skills `ad-analysis`, `scale-engine` e `finance-engine`. NUNCA estimar.

breakthroughs.description: IDs dos criativos de classe `breakthrough` (KPI do ad melhor que o da campanha E puxa spend). Escrito pela skill `ad-analysis`; e o gatilho de escala (`scale-engine`) e de reciclagem (`content-recycler`). Espelha `ad_classification[]` filtrado. Fonte canonica: `.claude/lib/ad-taxonomy/README.md` §2.

kpi_winners.description: IDs de classe `kpi_winner` — batem KPI mas nao puxam spend. NAO escalam e NAO reciclam (canone §2 trata como loser para decisao). Registrados para diagnostico e para o escape de forcar spend antes de descartar. Fonte canonica: `.claude/lib/ad-taxonomy/README.md` §2.

spend_winners.description: IDs de classe `spend_winner` — puxam spend mas KPI abaixo do da campanha. Entram apenas em iteracao (movimento 1 da skill `content-recycler`), nunca em escala. Fonte canonica: `.claude/lib/ad-taxonomy/README.md` §2.

10_ad_set_ids.description: IDs de TODOS os ad sets da campanha de teste (1 por conceito, estrutura CBO). Escrito pela skill `ad-strategy` / recipe full-deploy; lido por creative-loop e sync. Fonte canonica da estrutura atual.

phase_a_done.description: Fase A (flows de recuperacao) concluida. Escrito pela skill `retention-engine`; lido pela `retention-engine` (deteccao de fase) e pela `ad-strategy` (pre-flight).

retention.description: Estado da retencao por fases. Escrito pela skill `retention-engine`.

finance.description: Resumo financeiro gravado pela skill `finance-engine` (mode, breakeven_roas_with_fixed, cut_spend_recommendation_allowed, cash_needed_90d, runway_months, payback_window_days_measured, scale_ceiling_monthly_spend, checked_at). Consumidoras leem preferencialmente os paths do finance-engine/dados.json; este bloco e o atalho de leitura rapida.

shopify_product_ops.description: Operational product data no skill can derive: asked once to the member in page-build 6.1b (or by the deploy-shopify-product recipe) and reused from here on every later run.

initial_inventory.description: Units in stock at launch, split across tiers by the expected mix.

unit_weight_kg.description: Weight of one unit in kg; each tier weighs unit_weight_kg × qty. Feeds shipping rates.
